positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Design and implement a new fibre-channel system test in Ada and C to monitor and status radar hardware and its communication channels on a real-time operating system
- Maintain and optimize radar built-in calibration and system tests, system wide communication processes, external interface definitions, and instrumentation software for an existing legacy airborne radar platform
- Develop a new software tool in Python to improve flight data processing and collaborate with a colleague to design and introduce MongoDB database storage of information for faster data query and analysis
- Manually test and integrate embedded code implementation in an emulation software and in a software integration laboratory using real radar hardware and signal generator to produce test artifacts
- Identify flaws in radar software by analyzing instrumented flight test data and using knowledge of the software to understand why certain problems are observed by the customer
- Assist management by providing input to adopt an Agile process and streamline continuous integration of software product with nightly builds and automated testing using Jenkins and internal tools; Teams adopted and performed sprints and scrum meetings
- Contribute to software design processes by supporting preliminary and critical design presentations
- Mentor and answer questions from new team members and interns in their projects and tasks
- Conduct code and documentation peer reviews to adhere to software standards and agreements

positions.title: Associate Information Security Analyst
positions.description:
- Triage information security tickets.
- Respond to security alerts by contacting the various UCLA departments to resolve the issues.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Worked alongside seven other interns to build a film budgeting organizer that allows entertainment companies to monitor their films' production costs and incentives through their life cycle. Worked with AngularJS and Bootstrap for the front end. For the back end, we used Spring for inversion of control, Java for asynchronous requests processing, Jackson for JSON parsing, Hibernate for object-relational mapping, and Oracle PostgresSQL database to store information. We used subversion for version control and Trello to distribute tasks and manage flow of the project.

positions.title: Student Developer
positions.description: Write and test Matlab scripts to prepare inputs to an executable to perform simulations regarding radiation belts around Earth and plot the results with graphs. Maintained and wrote documentation for the scripts.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Engineering with Specialization in Data Science

projects.title: Audio-Only Youtube
projects.description: A Mozilla Firefox extension that allows the user to toggle a black overlay on top of the Youtube video panel, while leaving the audio unaffected. Created using WebExtensions cross-browser system. If you are interested in using this add-on, you can find it at addons.mozilla.org.

projects.title: UCLA AIAA Unmanned Aerial System
projects.description: Working with other UCLA AIAA engineers on the artificial intelligence team to build an image recognition system for the drone using Python and Matlab. The drone is supposed to navigate a test course and recognize and remember signs along the way.
